title: Hold more than one role and switch between them
description: Someone who is, say, both a team leader and the business manager now switches roles from the top bar, and signs in next time as whichever they used last.
items: The role switcher sits at the top of every page, and only appears for people with more than one role
Admin is IT: users and roles, company settings, events and the audit trail are theirs alone
The business manager and CEO see every department and report
HR screens are open to the manager and above, as well as to HR
pending: Needs the P14-05 database change applied before this release goes live, or nobody can open user management.
